Jack plays table tennis with Amy every Thursday. Jack hopes to visit Paris one day. Jack's favorite animal is the rabbit. For example, the old fort has a cannon by the gate.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the weekly report by bike. Both of them like noodles and juice. Jack learned a lot about science. Maternity pay continues for half a year.
Jack wants to be a engineer in the future. The weather was windy that day. Amy is interested in drawing. We caught a small crab at the beach.
There are always many people at the coffee corner. Jack wrote about the day in the diary. The weekly report is one of the best places in the city.
